events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI designed to assist with IT support tasks, such as resetting passwords and looking up support tickets. There's no human on the other end; I'm here to help you with your request. If you're ready, please provide your employee ID so I can reset your password.
